chunks: From him, from Ja'far, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu Hamzah, who said:
I entered upon Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) while he was sitting on a carpet, and he said, 'O girl, bring me the carpet.'

key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ: Ali ibn al-Husayn, the fourth Imam
key_terms.نُمْرُقَةٍ: A type of carpet or rug

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn ask for when sitting on his carpet?
ai.summary: This concise narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the humility and accessibility of Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin), demonstrating that even the Ahl al-Bayt engaged in simple, domestic interactions with their servants. It serves as a practical model for social etiquette and the proper treatment of household staff within the Shia tradition of everyday conduct.
